specName: Record bug runs through the bug hooks
request:
Issue #987 slice w42: record bug runs through the six bug hooks. PR body must say `Closes #987` (this is the last open item).

Problem. Nothing records a bug run typed in chat today: Companion registers no bug hooks and writes no record for bugs. spec-kit's bundled `bug` extension fires six bug hook events (since spec-kit v1.1.3). They are model-run like every hook and carry no variables. assess has no hooks, so ideas stay out.

Owner decision 2026-11-17: the stamps go in a `.spec-context.json` per bug, the same store with the same guarantees as specs (history only grows, writes merge, status never moves backward, one cross-process lock; deterministic writes `by: extension`). Reuse the existing writer (`apps/speckit-extension/scripts/write-context.py` / `spec_context.py`); do not write a second writer.

Proposed. Register the six bug hooks in `apps/speckit-extension/extension.yml` with one-line commands under `apps/speckit-extension/commands/` that stamp the bug's boundaries for its slug into that bug's `.spec-context.json`, and have the Bugs pane (`apps/vscode/src/features/bugs/`) read them. Find the six hook event names and where the bug extension keeps a bug's folder/slug from the installed spec-kit bug extension (look under `.specify/extensions/bug*/` or the spec-kit source in the sandboxes/vault research) — do not guess them.

Acceptance:
- A chat bug run records assess, fix and test boundaries.
- Partial and early-stop outcomes are recorded.
- The slug stays continuous across stages.
- Engine-run bugs (read today by `apps/vscode/src/features/bugs/engineRuns.ts`) are not counted twice.

Follow-ons: a new command goes in `extension.yml` `provides.commands`; changelog line under `[Unreleased]` in `apps/speckit-extension/CHANGELOG.md` (and root CHANGELOG.md if the pane changes for users); no version bumps.
expectations: no hooks or record for ideas (assess extension has none)
no change to the bug extension's own commands or reports
context: area: apps/speckit-extension (extension.yml hooks, commands/, scripts/write-context.py, spec_context.py)
constraint: one store, one writer: reuse write-context.py
constraint: bug folders are .specify/bugs/<slug>/ owned by spec-kit's bundled bug extension 1.0.2

decisions.decision: Six hooks on before/after_bug_assess|fix|test calling two one-line commands
decisions.why: the bundled bug extension 1.0.2 checks exactly these keys

decisions.decision: write-context.py gains --bug <slug> that targets .specify/bugs/<slug>/ and allows assess|fix|test as steps
decisions.why: one writer, one lock; non-canonical steps already record without status
decisions.rejected: adding bug stages to the canonical steps

decisions.decision: The finish reads the outcome from the stage's report
decisions.why: deterministic, the report already holds it

decisions.decision: The page shows the engine run when one exists, else the record
decisions.why: one source per page means each stage once

decisions.decision: A bug start always opens a new round unless the stage's last entry is already a start
decisions.why: a bug is re-fixed after a failed test; the spec rule of one start per step would drop the second round
decisions.rejected: reusing update_context, which dedups starts per step

decisions.decision: The pane reads the record only when there is no engine run
decisions.why: an engine run fires the same hooks, so two sources would show each stage twice

plan.key_finding: The bug commands skip after hooks on early stops, so a start without a finish is the stop signal
